features.reach: Navigate directly to /; loads WordPress ACF home fields or local fallback site-content.json.

Swipe View From the Bars carousel
Play YouTube spotlight facade

Inspect discount badge cards and codes
Navigate back Home via top nav
features.verify: node tools/control-bike-challenge.mjs request GET /offers --contains "Gear we Trust" && node tools/control-bike-challenge.mjs browse --path /offers --record

features.reach: Navigate to /blog; renders Gravel Union ride reports and gear guides.
actions: Browse article cards and read times
Open external Gravel Union articles
features.verify: node tools/control-bike-challenge.mjs request GET /blog --contains "Blog" && node tools/control-bike-challenge.mjs browse --path /blog --record

features.feature: Culture Cycling Club Rideout event & RSVP form
features.reach: Navigate to /event; renders rideout details, poster, and RSVP form submitting to /api/event-rsvp.
actions: Read rideout details
Submit Name and Email RSVP form

features.feature: Hidden Christmas Giveaway Lottery page & Join email modal

actions: View weekly prize drops and rules
Click Join to open email capture modal
Submit unique email entry to /api/xmas-lottery
features.verify: node tools/control-bike-challenge.mjs request GET /xmas-lottery --contains "Xmas lottery" && node tools/control-bike-challenge.mjs browse --path /xmas-lottery --record

actions: Return to home

actions: Validate name/email
Return confirmation JSON

features.feature: Xmas Lottery unique email entry endpoint
features.reach: POST /api/xmas-lottery with JSON { email }; enforces one entry per email and persists to Cloudflare KV XMAS_LOTTERY when bound.
actions: Validate and normalize email
Reject duplicate email with 409
Persist entry JSON to XMAS_LOTTERY KV

features.feature: Same-origin WordPress ACF REST API proxy
features.reach: GET /api/wp/acf/v3/options/options or GET /api/wp/wp/v2/pages?slug=...; proxies allowlisted WP endpoints server-side to eliminate client CORS errors on production and preview domains.
actions: Validate allowlisted WP endpoint and query params
Proxy upstream WP JSON with Cache-Control: no-store
Inspect commit SHA and deploy status HTML

features.reach: GET /health.json; returns { ok, status, commitSha, deploy }.
actions: Verify live commit SHA against expected merge SHA
